decisive_items: developed lower back pain and a tingling sensation radiating along the posterior aspect of her bilateral lower extremities
0/5 strength of the bilateral lower extremities (MRC scale)
Abnormal T2 cord signal from T8 to T9 disc level downwards to the conus medullaris
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms and examination results are more consistent with a spinal cord injury, given the sudden onset of lower back pain, tingling sensation, and bilateral lower-extremity weakness, as well as the abnormal T2 cord signal on MRI

rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for spinal cord compression beyond the abnormal T2 cord signal
